Method_Reported_By_Authors: Continuous Change Detection and Classification (CCDC) algorithm
Method_Evidence: In this study, the Continuous Change Detection and Classification (CCDC) algorithm was employed to estimate tree age. CCDC is known for its robust performance and capability to provide continuous monitoring of changes, enabling the analysis of land cover changes over time [42,45]. It utilizes the long time series Landsat data and NDVI and NBR data to establish the linear fitting model for each pixel based on Ordinary Least Squares (OLS), and the difference between predicted values and actual observations is calculated. If this difference exceeds three times the Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) for six consecutive times or more during the detection, the pixel is determined to be disturbed.
